question: What distinguishes the teacher when all appearances are equally conceptual?
premises: All appearances may be equally conceptual in status.
The teacher is characterized by a flash of oneness.
That oneness defines his realized state.
inference: The teacher is called accomplished and liberated because he abides in the flash of oneness amid equally conceptual appearances.
plain_english: When all things are equally conceptual, the teacher whose nature is a flash of oneness is called accomplished and liberated, being of one nature.
